method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (wrongs-core.l4: dates with built-in date functions only, the s 28G figures for 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2027 copied by hand from the deposited Gazette notice's WIRC Act s 340(b)(ii) row through the Note after s 28HAAB, and the rules) and one seat layer that restates no rule (wrongs-seat.l4, 38 questions with @export and @desc); two regulative rules (ss 28LO-28LQ; ss 28LW-28LWB), tested by EVALTRACE, never taken as inputs; no REFUSE (a case outside the encoding answers NOTHING, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Wrongs Act 1958 (Vic), Act No. 6420/1958, Version No. 130 as at 25 February 2026 (including Part XIIIA, inserted by No. 5/2026 s 3, in force 25 February 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/wrongs-act-1958.txt (sha256 cc5d5a7a30d972f6c30302100ce0d7b154dfd9fedde9336c678a37e262293083), converted from the Word file the owner saved by hand on 2026-11-06; s 28G figures from Victoria Government Gazette No. S 363 of 30 June 2026 (subjects/au/vic/workers-compensation-annual-indexation-notice/registers/source-bundle/GG2026S363.txt, sha256 04c8fe556bca3ef38185cf933965d9a6526da59cac06fb470eec02fe5945499a, line 703, the WIRC Act s 340(b)(ii) row), the 'Rate before 1 July 2026' column read as 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 and the 'Rate from 1 July 2026' column as 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027

seat: the injured person (the claimant or plaintiff who suffered injury, mental harm, economic loss or property damage), and, for Parts XIII and XIIIA, the person who was abused as a child; for s 26(4), the dependants of a person who died

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run wrongs-core.l4 ; l4 run wrongs-seat.l4 ; l4 run wrongs-cases.l4
checks.result: 238 written, 238 satisfied in wrongs-cases.l4; 0 errors, 0 warnings in all three files (2026-11-06)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read; a copy of the case file with two expected values changed was run first to confirm failures are reported (3 failed), and not kept.

scope: In: Part VB s 28B, s 28C(1), (2), (2A), s 28F, s 28G with s 28H, s 28I, ss 28IA, 28IB, 28ID(1)-(4), 28IE, 28IF; Part VBA s 28LB, s 28LC, s 28LE, s 28LF, s 28LK, ss 28LO(2)-(4), 28LP, 28LQ, 28LV, 28LW, 28LWA, 28LWB, 28LWE(1)(a), (3), s 28LZH, s 28LZN; Part X ss 44, 45, 48(1), 51(1), (2), 53-56, 59, 60, 63; Part V s 26(1), (4); Part XI ss 68, 69, 72-75; Part IVAA ss 24AF(1), 24AG, 24AI(1), 24AK, 24AM; Part XIII ss 88, 90, 91(2), (3), (5)-(7), 92(1), 93; Part XIIIA ss 93A(3), 93B, 93C(1), (3), 93D. Inputs: average weekly earnings, a prescribed discount rate, degree of impairment, the court's judgments (reasonable, satisfied, just, appropriate, obvious, inherent, akin to an employee, supplies the occasion, unreasonable peer opinion), the respondent's and Medical Panel's acts. Assumed: a proceeding commenced on or after 1 January 2004. Out: Parts I-IIC, III, IV, IVA, VA, VBAA, VC, VI-IX, XII, XIV; within the focus Parts, machinery, Division 3 assessment method, Medical Panel procedure, filing and stays, ss 46, 47, 49, 50, 57, 58, 61, 62, s 26(1A)-(6) other than (4), ss 24AF(2), (3), 24AH(2), 24AI(2), (3), 24AJ, 24AL, 24AN-24AP, ss 89, 92(2), (3), 93C(2), (4), (5) as factors only, and the transitionals. See NOTES.md.
